3259-4478-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached and that doesn't have summoning sickness.
3259-4478-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

654-2511-2577-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2511-2577-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-3249-4054-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4054-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-3899--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-4314-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-4314-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Pawn of Ulamog triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

1879-2043-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
1879-2043-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

3532-4668-5078-6792.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

5256-6972-7727.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1722-4050-7687.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-4050-7687.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and to put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
When the Tentacle enters, Mister Fantastic triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {1}.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

5702-6763-7401.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
5702-6763-7401.notablePrerequisites: At least half of the basic lands in your library are Forests.
5702-6763-7401.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
When the Springbloom Druid token enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a land, then search your library for a basic Forest and another basic land and put them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer 
When the basic lands enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate both lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Springbloom Druid.
Repeat from step 3 until your library contains no basic lands.
5702-6763-7401.notes: You can perform this combo if half the basic lands in your library aren't Forests, but you won't be able to grab all basic lands unless you supplement {G} to compensate. While you will put all basic lands onto the battlefield, you'll have to sacrifice half of them to continue the combo. This won't affect how many landfall triggers, ETB triggers and creature tokens you get however.

206-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

628-2034-7219.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Reaper.
When The Reaper dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Reaper enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1409-1780-2557.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

250-779-1315-1479-4677.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1315-1479-4677.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

60-232-1235-5913.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Pinnacle Monk tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Expansion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-1632-4853.description:
Activate Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Stonespeaker Crystal.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2232-2292-3821-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2292-3821-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

1690-2538-2585-6289.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
1690-2538-2585-6289.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the artifact cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2538-2585-6289.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

224-225-280-1772.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-280-1772.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

751-1770-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can produce at least {2}{U}.
751-1770-3821.description:
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon.
Resolve one Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Resolve the remaining Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them to add at least {2}{U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers itself twice due to Panharmonicon, returning itself and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If you can produce at least one additional mana in step 4, this combo produces infinite mana.

890-2210-2410.notablePrerequisites:

890-2210-2410.description:

Repeat.

When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Birchlore Rangers's power.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1174-1257-1846-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Walking Atlas.
You control at least two Islands that enters the battlefield untapped.

Activate two Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a tapped Island to your hand, untapping another Island.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting an Island from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat from step 2.

360-1981-4365-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
360-1981-4365-4591-4740.description:

Darien triggers, creating 100 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1182-4321-4772-5270.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Stonecoil Serpent to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

283-1978-2922-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Voltaic Construct.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
283-1978-2922-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {1}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Obscura Storefront from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Obscura Storefront enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Plains, Island or Swamp and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, targeting Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Voltaic Construct's ability, targeting Scaretiller.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the original Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

638-1470-1980.description:
Cast any other spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Hinder by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting that spell.
Swarm Intelligence and Thrumming Stone trigger.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, creating a copy of Hinder, targeting the original Hinder.
Resolve the copy of Hinder, countering the original Hinder and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Thrumming Stone trigger from step 3, revealing the top four cards of your library and casting Hinder without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

2793-4331.notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
2793-4331.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell.
resolve both Ugin's Nexus spells.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to legend rule, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

261-476-539-1491-4878.notablePrerequisites:
Sinking Feeling and Market Festival attached to Questing Phelddagrif.
Questing Phelddagrif does not have summoning sickness.
261-476-539-1491-4878.description:
Activate Questing Phelddagrif by tapping it, adding {G}.
Market Festival triggers, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Questing Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn and causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Hippo creature token.
The Hippo enters the battlefield, triggering Suture Priest's second ability, causing the opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Questing Phelddagrif's third ability to cause any number of opponent to draw infinite cards.

2440-3263-3705-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2440-3263-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {1}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Squee enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
